citations.title: Take a Look Inside the Scandit Vision AI Engine
excerpts: [Christian Floerkemeier](https://www.scandit.com/authors/christian-floerkemeier/) VP Product, CTO & Co-Founder

Our [barcode scanning](https://www.scandit.com/products/barcode-scanning/) products share a unified codebase and common machine learning models. [ID scanning](https://www.scandit.com/products/id-scanning/) and [ShelfView](https://www.scandit.com/products/shelfview/) are technically distinct — but they're built by the same team, draw on the same deep expertise, and follow the same principles.

Scene parsing identifies trays, shelves, products, and shelf labels. Products are identified down to the SKU level with image recognition. OCR and barcode scanning are used on shelf labels to extract product and price information. Together, they create a precise digital representation of the shelf (often called a realogram).
